label: Domain.com.au Scraper
title: Domain.com.au Scraper: Listings, Agents & Schools
metaDescription: Scrape domain.com.au property listings from any search URL: prices, agent contacts, nearby schools, market insights, photos and floor plans.
intro: Paste a domain.com.au search link (any filters) and get each listing's price, agent contacts, nearby schools, market insights, photos and floor plans.
useCases: Compare prices and days on market across suburbs
Build agent contact lists by suburb
Track new listings that match a buyer's brief

faq.a: Yes, Domain runs a developer portal, but listing data in production needs an approved plan. This actor needs no key: paste any domain.com.au search link and it returns every listing in it.

faq.q: Can I keep my filters from domain.com.au?
faq.a: Yes. Set price, bedrooms, property type and area on domain.com.au, copy the link and paste it; every filter carries over. Buy, rent and sold searches all work.

faq.q: Can I use it as a domain.com.au API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Domain offers a developer API with a sandbox; production listing data needs an approved plan. This actor reads the public search results on domain.com.au for any search link.
